Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS to a classmate.

3. Practise this skill: apply Islamic greeting related to Islamic greeting. appropriately while • In pairs or small groups.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP1 learner study Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS?
